name: The First Night
about: The opening quest line for a new game: a whole first day on Earth (the Humming Oak: meeting the town, the oak's mystery, three clues and three glowing acorns, the oak's door opening at midnight), then the first Void day. scripts/first_night.gd and scripts/humming_oak.gd glue it to the rest of the game. Every step can be skipped from the quest log.

steps.text: It's a sunny morning in Stars Hollow, and someone's knocking! Say hi to Nina outside, then go and meet the town.
checklist: Talk to Nina, outside your house
Meet Mr. Palmer by the gazebo
Say hello to two more people round the green

steps.text: Nina says the old oak on the green hums every midnight. Go and listen to it.
Something's ticking inside the old oak! Find out what's going on before midnight.
checklist: Ask Mr. Page at Turn the Page (the bookshop) about the old oak
Look at the lilac envelope on Mr. Palmer's porch
Find 3 glowing acorns: Mossy Falls, the pumpkin patch, Lookout Hill

steps.text: The sun's going down. Put the three glowing acorns in the nook in the old oak's roots.
The runes on the old oak are glowing! Something will happen at midnight. Sleep in your bed "Until the Shift" to get there quicker, or explore till then.
It's midnight! Go to the old oak and see what happens.
The door in the old oak is open! Walk into the swirl to cross over, then find out who's waiting on the other side.
A whole day in the Void! Dash, Rex and Tally all have something to show you.
checklist: Pop 3 Gloops with your Star Popper
Look at Dash's gadget stall by the fountain
Skate Park: push along with Coach Rook
Finish a request from Tally's board
Find the lost watch on the Market fountain

steps.text: Everyone's whispering about a big golden Gloop out in the west fields, past the Market. Pop the Gloop King, then tell Dash!
checklist: Pop the Gloop King in the west fields

steps.text: What a day! Enjoy the Void till the Shift ends at 7 AM, when the portal pulls you home. Then find Nina.

reward.message: That was the first night of many. The portal opens again every midnight. (+10 sparkles)
